stories.title: Record number of NCA officers deployed to tackle people smugglers
stories.summary: The Home Office and National Crime Agency have deployed a record number of officers to disrupt people-smuggling networks, with new measures aimed at faster removal of those with no right to remain in the UK.

stories.title: Home Office targets AI-generated savings with police non-emergency phone line
stories.summary: The Home Office is rolling out an AI-powered call-routing system for the 101 non-emergency police line that could save up to £8.5m a year and reduce waiting times for callers.

stories.title: Foreign Secretary statement on Government of Israel E1 settlement project tender
stories.summary: The Foreign Secretary issued a formal statement responding to the Government of Israel's launch of a tender for the controversial E1 settlement project in the West Bank.

stories.title: DWP to recruit 480 additional staff to tackle Access to Work backlog
stories.summary: DWP announced it will recruit 480 additional staff to address the Access to Work scheme backlog, bringing the total to over 1,100 staff dedicated to processing disability employment support applications.

stories.title: Coordinated drought response intensifies amid extreme weather
stories.summary: DEFRA has announced a £65 million package to support farmers through extreme drought conditions, including increased flood funding and plans for nine new reservoirs across England.

stories.title: Tackling drought: aquifer recharging to smart irrigation trials
stories.summary: DEFRA's farming blog details a package of drought support measures including £50 million for farmers, with trials of aquifer recharging and smart irrigation technology to improve water resilience.

stories.title: Bird flu (avian influenza): Great Britain declares freedom from HPAI
stories.summary: The UK has self-declared freedom from highly pathogenic avian influenza (bird flu) for Great Britain as of 18 May 2026, with ongoing monitoring guidance for bird keepers.

stories.title: British weapons jobs rise by more than 50% in a year as defence investment strengthens UK industry
stories.summary: UK weapons and ammunition manufacturing jobs rose by 51% in 2024/25, part of a wider increase of 26,000 defence-supported roles nationwide, reflecting significant increases in defence spending.

stories.title: MOD supported employment estimates: 2024/25
stories.summary: The MoD has published updated employment estimates for 2024/25, showing combined direct and indirect jobs supported by defence spending across the UK, with some revisions to prior year figures.

stories.title: ICO warns over expanding backlog as complaint caseload grows threefold in a year
stories.summary: The Information Commissioner's Office has warned that its backlog of FOI complaints is growing by 400 cases a month after missing out on requested funding at the last spending review, with the caseload tripling over the past year.

stories.title: Boohoo fined €2.3m by French watchdog over deceptive discounts
stories.summary: The French consumer watchdog fined UK-listed fashion retailer Boohoo €2.3 million for misleading discount practices, adding to regulatory pressure on the British fast-fashion sector.

stories.title: 'It's a bit odd at first': The robot helping with NHS health checks
stories.summary: A BBC report explores how a new robotic system is being used to assist with NHS health checks, with patients and clinicians sharing early impressions of the technology in action.

stories.title: Hospital solar farm officially opened at Royal Wolverhampton NHS Trust
stories.summary: A solar farm powering New Cross Hospital has been officially opened, marking a significant step in The Royal Wolverhampton NHS Trust's commitment to reducing its carbon footprint.
